# SimRig

> {{ site.description | strip_newlines }}

SimRig is a desktop app for Linux (x86-64), written in Rust, licensed GPL-3.0-or-later. Each brand is supported by a plugin that knows its devices and, when needed, bundles the open source kernel driver they use (hid-fanatecff, hid-universal-pidff, new-lg4ff, the Logitech TrueForce driver, hid-tmff2, hid-t150, simagic-ff), built with DKMS. It needs root only to install a driver, through polkit, and leaves nothing running when closed. It is in early development: most models work on simulated devices but are not yet tested on real hardware; each page says what was tested.
